title: SHIELD Lab co-organized and presented a clean-energy innovation panel
summary: SHIELD Lab co-organized and presented a panel on digital engineering, AI and cybersecurity at the Illinois Innovation Network Conference 2026.
details: Illinois Innovation Network Conference 2026: Powering Illinois’ Future Together · October 2026 · Southern Illinois University Edwardsville.
Session: Accelerating Clean Energy Innovation through Digital Engineering, AI, and Cybersecurity. Location: Health Sciences 1330.
Moderator: Todd Rusk, Associate Director, University of Illinois EnergySense Resilience Center.
SIUC panelists: Md Amzad Hossain; Abdur Rahman Bin Shahid; Md Zahidul Islam; Additya Barua; Syed Mhamudul Hasan; Md Sayed Hasan Rifat.
imageAlt: Dr. Shahid presenting the SHIELD Lab slide at the Illinois Innovation Network conference

title: Edits in the Wild accepted to EMNLP 2026
summary: Our multilingual benchmark for localizing on-device generative image edits was accepted to the EMNLP 2026 main conference.
details: Edits in the Wild: A Multilingual Benchmark for Localizing On-Device Generative Image Edits on Consumer Platforms.

title: Soumik presented No Innocence in Styling at ACL 2026
summary: Mohd. Farhan Israk Soumik presented No Innocence in Styling at ACL 2026 in San Diego, sharing research on privacy protection and security risks in consumer generative AI writing assistants.
details: No Innocence in Styling: Discovery of Privacy Protection Capabilities and Security Risks in Consumer Generative AI Writing Assistants appeared in the ACL 2026 Industry Track.

title: Sponge Attacks on Sensing AI
summary: Investigating energy–latency vulnerabilities and model-pruning defenses in sensing AI.

title: Soumik presented Edits in the Wild in Budapest
summary: Mohd. Farhan Israk Soumik presented the Edits in the Wild poster at EMNLP 2026 in Budapest, Hungary.
details: The presentation shared our multilingual benchmark for localizing on-device generative image edits on consumer platforms. The paper appeared in the EMNLP 2026 main conference.

title: Quantum attention research accepted as an ICTAI full paper
summary: When Quantum Entanglement Meets Transformer Attention: A Controlled Study of Quantum Attention Heads was accepted as a full paper at ICTAI 2026.
details: The work studies quantum attention heads within transformer architectures.

title: Congratulations to Malithi on her CVPR 2026 scholarship
summary: Malithi received the CVPR 2026 Broadening Participation Scholarship Award and attended CVPR in Denver, where her sensor–text alignment research was part of the Sense of Space workshop.
details: Breaking Sensor-Text Alignment: Cross-Modal Attack on Contrastive Multimodal Human Activity Recognition investigates attacks on contrastive multimodal activity recognition.
The Sense of Space workshop took place in June 2026. This work is a CVPR workshop contribution.
imageAlt: Malithi beside her Breaking Sensor-Text Alignment research poster at CVPR 2026 in Denver

title: Dr. Shahid presented sensor-based AI education work at NAIRR
summary: Dr. Shahid presented Developing Core AI Competencies Through Sensor Data and Large Language Models at the NAIRR Pilot Classroom Expansion Conference.
details: The Research Emerging – Large conference was held in June 2026, at Embassy Suites by Hilton Orlando Downtown.

title: Congratulations to Soumik on ACL 2026 support and service

title: Soumik selected as an EMNLP 2026 student volunteer

title: ACCESS Explore supports federated vision–language model research
summary: SHIELD Lab received ACCESS Explore resource support for research on privacy-induced cross-modal representation degradation in federated vision–language models.
details: Understanding and Mitigating Privacy-Induced Cross-Modal Representation Degradation in Federated Vision-Language Models. The active allocation runs October 2026–October 2027.

title: NSF ACCESS Regional AI Workshop grant awarded to SHIELD Lab
summary: The awarded grant will support Advancing AI Research, Education, and Workforce Development in Southern Illinois and the Midwest, a one-day hybrid workshop planned for September 2027 at Southern Illinois University Carbondale.
details: The upcoming workshop will bring together regional audiences around AI education, interdisciplinary AI research and workforce development.
The planned program includes ACCESS and NAIRR resources, AI+ degree pathways, hands-on GPU labs and responsible AI.

title: NAIRR Classroom grant supports hands-on AI safety education

Dr. Abdur Rahman Bin Shahid is principal investigator. The resource allocation period is June–December 2026; the grant announcement is dated July 2026.
